data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name ‘Yoel’ meaning ‘God of Jehovah’ or ‘God of God’. In the Old Testament, Yoel is the name of a prophet who heralded the coming of the Lord. In Christianity, Yoel is considered a strong, powerful, and inspiring name. The name Yoel carries the meaning “God of Jehovah” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yoel usually hope their child will grow to embody god of jehovah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yoel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
